title: Scholarships of the Republic of Croatia (Bilateral)
provider: Ministry of Science, Education and Youth and the Agency for Mobility and EU Programmes (AMPEU)
description: Bilateral scholarships offering a study or research stay (3 to 10 months) at an accredited public Croatian higher education or research institution for citizens of countries with an education agreement with Croatia.
amount: EUR 300 per month (undergraduate/graduate), EUR 320 (PhD) or EUR 480 (postdoctoral), plus possible accommodation support

title: Croatian Government Scholarships for the Croatian Language (Croaticum)
provider: University of Zagreb Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences / Ministry of Science, Education and Youth
description: Government-funded places on the semester-long Croaticum programme of Croatian language and culture at the University of Zagreb, aimed at foreign students and members of the Croatian diaspora.
amount: Tuition-free place plus, for some awards, a monthly allowance

title: University of Zagreb Institutional Scholarships
description: Tuition reductions and merit awards for international students enrolled on a fee-paying basis at Croatia's largest and oldest university.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction (varies by faculty)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Croatia-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including Croatian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
